effect.monsterexpansion.bleeding.guidebo: Makes you take damage over time. This effect can stack, making the damage interval shorter. On its own, the damage isn't anything to be afraid of, but it can be devastating if its allowed to stack up. This status' duration will go down slower depending on how fast you are moving. To get rid of it the fastest, the hunter must crouch while staying still.
Makes you unable to move nor attack for a short duration. This status is very common and can be inflicted by most monsters' roars. However as common as it is, the monsters also do not attack when roaring, making the status not as dangerous. As the effect will likely end before the monster can finish roaring.
effect.monsterexpansion.flarevein.guideb: Makes you take damage over time. This effect can stack, making the damage interval shorter. On its own, the damage isn't anything to be afraid of, but it can be devastating if its allowed to stack up. This status' duration will go down slower depending on how slow you are moving. To get rid of it the fastest, the hunter must be sprinting, or even better, roll around until the status is cured. The hunter must be careful as to not stay still, as doing so will increase the duration instead.
effect.monsterexpansion.frostvein.guideb: Makes you move slower, attack slower and jump lower. This effect can stack, making the movement speed decrease more severe. This effect can really be devastating if its allowed to stack up as you may not be able to jump over even a singular block. This status currently does not have a remedy making it incredibly dangerous if the hunter is fighting in rough terrain.
effect.monsterexpansion.stunned.guideboo: Makes you unable to move nor attack for a short duration. This can be inflicted by all monsters if the hunter is often hit by attacks. The effect instantly ends if the hunter is hit again. The damage source does not matter, making allies and self-inflicted damage a viable way to end the effect early. However this effect is still very dangerous as the monster may follow up with a devastating attack before the hunter can recover.

item.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.ent: We reached the location to which He bade us journey, a laborious march spanning many days. As the sun surrendered to dusk, we rested our wearied bodies upon the earth for what I trust to be the final time. This morn,
we rose with purpose anew, and began to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.

Our construction draws nigh its completion. As I pen these very words, the final shipment of supplies flow into our haven - enough timber, freshly hewn from the surrounding wilds, to finish the enclosure, and panes of glass
sent from Fort Greater. Soon shall the research commence, the likes of which may yet shake the pillars of the world.

A strange unease takes root within my mind. This magic - though wondrous - doth twist the senses. I could have sworn there was a cellar beneath the chapel's floor, and yet now none recall it. Even my most trusted lieutenant
claims such a thing never was. Am I alone in this delusion? Has madness begun to gnaw at me?
Our scouts return with tidings of a village, not far from our encampment. This is good news, for supplies dwindle. We shall lay siege and easily procure what is needed, for the distance is not great.
However, the magical research in these lands proves troublesome - few are the answers we seek. It may soon come to pass that we abandon this place, move to the next site.
item.irons_spellbooks.archevoker_log.pag: We arrived at the location He sent us to just before last dusk, a march of many days. One last time, we slept on the dirt; this morning we rose with purpose anew, beginning to etch a barrier of logs and home of stone.
Construction is near complete. As I write, supplies make their way into our hospice - freshly hewn wood from the area, a shipment of glass from fort greater. Discovery awaits.

I had never thought it possible, this magic seems to be messing with my mind. I swear there used to be a cellar below the chapel, yet even my second in command says it were never so... Surely I cannot be the one going mad?

Scouts have returned with fantastic news, that of a village, and not too far to return the supplies here with ease after laying siege. However, magical research in this area seems to be inconclusive. We may be abandoning soon.

logbook.aquamirae.pirate_outpost.content:
Entry #34

These beasts from the depths prowl for someone to devour... One of those critters has already eaten our midshipman... Swallowed him whole along with his crossbow.

Entry #35

We are waiting in vain for rescue... No one will come to help us, we have to survive on our own. Today the construction of the fort from parts of the ship was completed. In any case, she could no longer plow the seas ever again.

Entry #36

We are no longer able to heat the fort, resources are running out. Part of the crew began to dig a shelter underground. It is the only way we have a chance not to freeze to death.

Entry #37

We hid our supplies and valuable cargo underground. But Poseidon cursed us, and during the storm the lieutenant washed away into the sea... Along with master keys.

The hope remains that we could possibly find similar keys on other ships of our fleet, which have suffered the same fate as us.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_shelter.content:
Entry #41

In these cursed lands there you can't find shelter even under the ice and the thickness of the earth... Some creatures that look like eels crawled out of the depths of the underworld, depriving us of the opportunity to return back to the surface.

Only the mistress of the moon knows how long shall we last... At all events, our hopes of seeing sunlight had all but vanished. This place will become our grave, our eternal tomb. For us and that damned rune...

Last Entry

It whispers to me, whispers inside my head the secrets of ice and snow... Ice... Now we are chained in ice forever...

I suppose a similar fate awaits the crew that set out in search of the fire rune... I wonder if they made it to the Great Dark Forest valley. Though it doesn't really matter now.
logbook.aquamirae.pirate_ship.content:
Entry #12

Last afternoon, Captain Cornelia went to the seabed in search of any additional resources. There are rumors among the crew that the real subject of her expedition is something else.

More than a day has passed since the captain's dive. She was wearing the only diving suit we had, so we couldn't help her in any way. Worst of all, she had the master key with her. As our hopes of rescue dwindle, the threat of rebellion grows.

monsterology.monsterexpansion.ignathos.f: Ignathos' base attacks can be easily evaded using dodge rolls. As the fight progresses, Ignathos will search for and consume any valid fuel blocks nearby. Upon eating the fuel, it enters an ignited state, unlocking new flame-based abilities and empowering its standard moves. While ignited, both its beak strikes and its newly acquired flame-spitting attacks deal Fire damage and have a chance to inflict the Flarevein effect. The primary danger here is Flarevein, which will ramp up in severity if not addressed quickly. To cure the affliction, simply sprint or perform dodge rolls until it dissipates. When enraged, Ignathos gains the ability to spew a massive glob of flaming goo. Although this attack boasts increased damage and a wider area of effect, the beast suffers from a short recovery period afterward, providing an excellent opening for a counterattack.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.ignathos.l:
Often referred to by frustrated locals as the "Brushfire Vandal," Ignathos is a medium-sized, flightless Avian covered in dense, heat-resistant plumage. Unlike most predators, this highly specialized creature is an obligate consumer of combustibles, sustaining itself entirely on a diet of raw wood, coal, and other flammable materials. Its anatomy is perfectly adapted for this bizarre ecological niche; it possesses unusually long arms ending in inward-pointing, vice-like claws that allow it to effortlessly grip, uproot, and pull solid blocks of fuel directly from the earth or human structures.

Once consumed, the materials enter a highly specialized stomach that acts as a biological furnace. Ignathos does not digest its food in a traditional sense; instead, it literally burns it, absorbing the resulting thermal and kinetic energy to fuel its own body. Because of its voracious appetite for fuel, particularly during the harsh winter months, unprepared villages often fall victim to its pillaging. However, Ignathos is naturally docile and strongly prefers to flee from confrontation. Over time, settlements situated near birch forests and other natural habitats have learned to coexist with the beast, leaving designated piles of scrap wood and coal on the outskirts of town to prevent the creature from dismantling their houses or raiding freshly mined stockpiles.

Despite its somewhat dopey appearance and timid nature, Ignathos is not defenseless. If it detects genuine hostility and feels it cannot safely escape (or if it is fiercely protecting a particularly rich meal) it will fight back. By hyper-ventilating and forcefully expelling the burning contents of its stomach furnace, Ignathos can spew globs of highly adhesive, flaming goo over a wide area.

While Ignathos is considered physically weaker than most large monsters, seasoned hunters actively avoid confronting them whenever possible. This is not out of fear of the beast itself, but rather the catastrophic environmental damage it causes when panicked. A frightened or cornered Ignathos will spray its flaming goo wildly, easily igniting massive, uncontrollable forest fires that can devastate an entire biome.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.leivekilth: Leivekilth's attacks are slow, but its sheer size makes up for the lack of speed. Shattering its ice armor quickly is crucial, as breaking each section increases the damage the monster takes. Watch out for its belly flop attacks; the safest way to evade these is to run diagonally underneath the beast. Be equally cautious of its ice attacks, which can inflict Frostvein. This effect is highly dangerous if allowed to stack, eventually preventing you from jumping over blocks altogether. Upon enraging, Leivekilth will flip onto its back and begin to hover. Do not waste your resources trying to outrun it. Instead, the safest approach is to remain at its sides. This positioning keeps you clear of the ice spikes erupting directly beneath it, while also preventing the monster from targeting you with its ice breath or tail sweeps.

A colossal, solitary Therian bearing the traits of a walrus, but equipped with membranous wings, a heavy tail, and devastating saber-like tusks. Its fangs serve as a visual marker of its age and dominance.

Leivekilth possesses highly specialized organs that secrete volatile fluids capable of rapidly stripping salt from seawater and shifting freezing points. This also allows the creature to exhale sweeping jets of pure frost. Its thick blubber is laced with a sponge-like tissue, enabling it to absorb water and cloak itself in a dense armor of regenerative ice.

Despite its immense weight, Leivekilth is terrifyingly agile in short bursts, the sheer muscle mass of the creature allows it to leap great distances and even take flight for brief periods. However when enraged, utilizing its blowholes to push freezing air at high speeds, it can temporarily transition into its flying state. This phase is extremely dangerous, as its bodily fluids can now rapidly drip below, flash freezing the ground at impact and creating razor sharp ice spikes. Or increasing the rate and pressure of its blowhole exhalations to supercool the ground below it, creating a massive icy shockwave.

Leivekilth are notoriously brutal with its prey, preserving them in ice and impaling them upon its jagged back spines. These macabre displays serve to store food, assert dominance, and attract mates. During breeding season, its lairs are decorated with mountainous heaps of frozen corpses, a grim warning that stepping foot into its territory is an absolute death sentence.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.rakoth.fig: Rakoth excels at mid-to-short range, so it is best to avoid lingering at these distances. Watch out for its tail attacks, which possess a wide area of effect and can be devastating if caught off guard. Rakoth inflicts more stun than any other monster; taking damage three times in quick succession will almost certainly leave you immobilized. Because the beast is typically very slow, most of its attacks can be easily dodged with proper positioning. After sustaining enough damage, Rakoth will occasionally curl into a ball and attempt to crush you. If you see it suddenly running in an unusual direction, it is preparing to initiate this rolling attack. Do not allow it to create distance, as this gives it the space needed to freely turn and home in on you. Instead, chase after it. If you stay close enough, its turning radius will be restricted, forcing it to helplessly circle around you instead of landing a direct hit.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.rakoth.lor:
A massive, four-legged Lacertian geovore characterized by the heavily armored, rocky shell covering its back. Rakoth primarily roams the arid expanses of badlands and deserts, relentlessly searching for exposed mineral veins and precious metals to sustain itself.

Equipped with a thick, reinforced skull and prominent frontal horns, this beast routinely headbutts solid cliff faces to excavate its metallic diet. While typically docile toward humans, its insatiable hunger for ore makes it extremely dangerous to fully equipped hunters. Rakoth is known to mistake the glint of metallic armor for a walking feast, charging relentlessly to crack open the hunter and consume the raw iron or gold within.

Despite its cumbersome, rocky exterior, hunters must not be deceived by its apparent sluggishness. Rakoths can launch into a terrifyingly swift gallop. If severely threatened, it will tuck its head and tail inward, transforming into a massive, rolling boulder of pure physical destruction. While this rolling charge delivers devastating blunt-force trauma capable of flattening anything in its path, the beast's vision and turning radius are severely compromised in this state, allowing nimble hunters to evade and counterattack.

Beyond its horns and rolling charge, Rakoth boasts a remarkably thick, armored tail used for crushing blows. During mating season, the arid plains echo with rhythmic, thunderous tremors as rival males repeatedly slam their heavy tails into the dirt. This display of raw physical power serves both as a call to potential mates and a violent warning to any competing males in the territory.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.rhyza.figh: Much like Ignathos, most of Rhyza's base attacks can be easily evaded using dodge rolls, though its overall attack speed is noticeably faster. When enraged, Rhyza gains access to two new abilities: Flash and Invisibility. Avoiding the Flash is simple; Rhyza will deliberately dash into your field of vision, so simply look away, preferably in the opposite direction of its dash, to avoid being blinded. Invisibility is a bit trickier, as there is no way to predict where Rhyza will emerge around you. Rather than trying to guess, it is better to rely on a reactive dodge roll. If you do not immediately see the beast, assume it is preparing to strike from behind and roll accordingly.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.rhyza.lore:
A highly elusive, carnivorous Chimeran native to the barren, floating islands of the End. Characterized by its twin tails and specialized forelimbs, the Rhyza is a deadly anomaly in an already alien landscape. Unlike other predators that rely on crushing jaws, this beast rarely utilizes its sharp teeth in combat. Instead, it wields elongated, jagged claws with terrifying precision, evolved specifically to slash and perforate. Even if a target manages to deflect the brunt of a physical strike, the deep, serrated lacerations left behind inflict severe and continuous bleeding.

Despite its lethal anatomy, the Rhyza is naturally cautious and actively avoids unnecessary confrontation. It navigates the desolate void using advanced evasion tactics, primarily shifting into complete invisibility, to stalk small prey or bypass threats. Ecologists have recently discovered that what appears to be pale, white fur is actually a dense coat of microscopic, incredibly complex mirror-like structures. These organic, yet-to-be-understood prisms perfectly bend light around the creature's body, rendering it entirely unseen in its environment.

If cornered, it reveals its secondary defense mechanism: the bulbous, gleam-infused cores at the ends of its twin tails. By smashing these cores together or against the ground, the Rhyza detonates a blinding, disorienting flash of light, allowing it to vanish. However, if the creature is provoked into a lethal encounter, these evasive tools are weaponized, allowing the beast to blind its target and strike from unseen angles with terrifying, omnidirectional leaps.

This timid nature completely inverts during mating season. Expectant female Rhyzas become hyper-aggressive, entirely abandoning their natural invisibility to ruthlessly hunt down anything that moves within their territory. Ecologists theorize this violent behavioral shift is a preemptive evolutionary imperative, a brutal campaign to purge the surrounding islands of any potential threats before giving birth, ensuring the absolute safety of its vulnerable offspring.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.skrythe.fi: When engaging a Skrythe, avoid lingering in mid-range, as this is where its attacks, particularly its roar, are most devastating. Fighting at close range prevents you from simply outrunning strikes, forcing you to rely on diagonal dodge rolls to evade. This dynamic completely shifts when the Skrythe becomes enraged. You must abandon close-quarters combat during this state, as it can unleash a Seismic Roar at any moment. This attack is instantly fatal at point-blank range and still inflicts massive damage further out, so your best strategy is to keep your distance and bait the attack. If you back away too far while the enraged beast is airborne, it will trigger an Aerial Assault. As it ascends to fire sound spheres, do not waste stamina dodging them, as they deal negligible damage. Instead, immediately sprint directly underneath the Skrythe. The true threat is its subsequent angled dive, which boasts an incredibly long forward reach. Positioning yourself directly below the monster is the most reliable way to evade the dive completely.
monsterology.monsterexpansion.skrythe.lo:
A highly territorial carnivorous Wyvern characterized by its dense, ash-grey scales and striking azure wing membranes. The Skrythe thrives in most regions and can be sighted throughout the world migrating or looking for food.

Rather than relying on a breath weapon, its throat houses a highly specialized organ capable of generating devastating, high-frequency vibrations. The prominent blue frills crowning Skrythe's head are not merely for display. They are highly complex biological parabolic reflectors. When the wyvern produces a sound, these frills flare outward to amplify, focus, and aim the vibrations, turning a deafening roar into a localized, kinetic shockwave capable of pulverizing solid rock and shattering the bones of its prey.

To counterbalance the force of its own sonic blasts, Skrythe has developed a heavily calcified, rigid tail. While it prefers to fight at a distance using acoustics, it will ruthlessly swing this hardened tail like a mace to crush anything that manages to get too close.

Skrythe was the very first apex predator officially documented by early explorers. Before humanity understood the true dangers of the world, a massive grey shadow blotted out the sun, accompanied by a deafening roar that shattered village windows. It was the creature that taught the world to look up and fear the skies. Which is why its titled 'First King of The Skies'

I was clearing out a new tunnel in the badlands and found this round, heavy rock blocking the tracks. It was about the size of a minecart, so I gave it a good whack with my pickaxe to break it up. Big mistake. The 'rock' uncurled, roared, and headbutted my actual minecart off the rails! It's a Rakoth, but it's only half the size of the massive ones we usually see on the surface. Don't let the compact size fool you, it still hits like a runaway train. Go clear it out of our shaft so we can get back to work!
quest.monsterexpansion.a_burning_nuisanc: Listen here, rookie! I know we're supposed to leave out scrap wood to keep those dopey birds happy, but a particularly greedy Ignathos just broke into my yard and made off with a whole stack of my premium crafting coal! I can't forge any armor if my fuel keeps getting treated like an all-you-can-eat buffet. Head out to the woods and teach that overgrown turkey a lesson. Just... try not to panic it near the tree line, yeah? We don't need a forest fire today.
quest.monsterexpansion.a_flash_in_the_da: I know the End isn't exactly a peaceful garden, but normally those pests just turn invisible and run away when I come to harvest Chorus Fruit. Well, not this one. I barely took two steps before it dropped its camouflage, flashed me blind, and came at me swinging those awful claws. The ecologists at camp told me she must be nesting, which means no one is safe near her territory. I need you to go clear it out so I can get back to my research. And hey, bring some bandages, those scratches do NOT stop bleeding!
quest.monsterexpansion.bloody_waters.des: We thought it was just a rogue iceberg drifting into the shipping lanes. Then it turned and rammed our hull. It's a leviathan, Hunter, a colossal beast cloaked in thick frost, with tusks that sheared right through our reinforced bow. As we abandoned ship, the fog cleared enough for me to see its back. It had massive marine predators, sharks and whales, completely frozen and skewered along its spine like grim trophies. It blasted the water with a freezing wind, locking our ruined ship in the floe to mark its new territory. Hunt it down before it pushes any further south.
quest.monsterexpansion.forged_in_ice.des: I'm trying to design a new type of cooling forge, and I need intact Leivekilth materials to make it work. I know hunting a Leivekilth is a massive risk, but if you can isolate one and bring me its parts, I'll forge you a weapon that'll freeze the sea itself.
We finally struck a massive raw gold vein in the badlands ravine, but the noise of our pickaxes attracted a Rakoth. It started eating the ore straight out of the cavern walls! Get in there and crack its shell before it devours our entire payout. Feel free to keep any of the heavy carapace you break off of it, I hear it makes fantastic plating.
quest.monsterexpansion.resonance_and_rui: I thought I was tough enough to take on a Skrythe solo. I was wrong. It shattered my iron shield with one of those sonic blasts and nearly took my head off. I plan on getting my revenge eventually, but first, I need an upgrade. Go hunt one down and bring me back a few of its calcified tail-bones. I'm going to forge a new hammer out of the very thing that beat me.
quest.monsterexpansion.silence_the_skies: WHAT? YOU'LL HAVE TO SPEAK UP! MY EARS ARE STILL RINGING! I was hauling a premium shipment of glass panes through the crossing when this massive grey shadow dropped out of nowhere. It flared up these blue things on its head and just... screamed! The sheer force of the sound shattered my entire cargo into dust! When I tried to scare it off, it swung a tail the size of an anvil and smashed my cart to splinters. I don't care what the guild calls it, just go out there and shut that flying menace up so I can do my job in peace!
quest.monsterexpansion.stolen_embers.des: Winter is setting in early, and one of those fire-birds just raided our communal woodpile again. We need to restock our firewood, but more importantly, the local tanner says Ignathos plumage makes for incredible thermal insulation. Head into the woods, track it down, and bring back enough feathers to line our winter coats.
quest.monsterexpansion.sunscorched_vanda: We have a massive problem on the dry plains. An Ignathos was sighted in the Savanna. Between the scorching sun and the dry brush, its internal furnace has completely overheated. It is permanently ignited, hyper-aggressive, and turning the grass to ash with every step. If we don't put this bird down immediately, the entire biome is going to go up in smoke.
quest.monsterexpansion.the_badlands_bite: Ravines out here are dangerous, so I spent my life savings on a brand-new set of heavy Iron armor. Turns out, to a Rakoth, that just makes me look like a premium, canned meal! I was barely swinging my pickaxe before this massive, rocky lizard charged at me, trying to crack me open like a geode. I dropped my tools and ran, but the overgrown pebble curled up into a boulder and literally flattened my entire campsite. I can still hear it slamming its tail out there. Go deal with it!
quest.monsterexpansion.thermal_shock.des: An Ignathos has wandered far outside its natural habitat, tracking deep into the frozen shores. That kind of reckless, erratic behavior leads us to believe it is a Tempered specimen. There is a Leivekilth territory dangerously close to a nearby coastal settlement. If the Ignathos agitates the leviathan, the resulting rampage will cause great harm to the village. We cannot take any chances. Head to the coast and take them both out before the situation escalates.
quest.monsterexpansion.thermal_shock.obj: Slay a Leivekilth and Tempered Ignathos
quest.monsterexpansion.unseen_blade.desc: I've finally figured out how to weave that microscopic mirrored fur into a stealth cloak, but my workshop is completely out of materials. I need you to head into the Outer Islands and track down a Rhyza. They are going to be incredibly evasive. You'll have to keep a sharp eye out for their shimmering silhouettes and strike before they flashbang you and vanish.
quest.monsterexpansion.unseen_blade.name: Unseen Blade
research.mythsandlegends.ancient_copper_: There's nothing more to extract from this coin... but its secret lives on in what we've unlocked.
The engravings aren't decorative... they're structured, like instructions embedded into metal.
Fascinating... these markings suggest it wasn't just currency. It was part of a crafted system, perhaps even a forging key.
It all connects now. This coin is tied to a lost method of weapon creation... I'm close to reconstructing it.
My research is complete. I can now replicate the technique hidden within this coin.
Hmm... this ancient copper coin carries an unusual weight, almost as if it remembers every hand it passed through. Leave it with me, and I'll uncover its purpose.
The Antique Emblem is complete. May it shield you from the relentless blows of the Possessed Armors.
The fragments share a common pattern of damage. Whatever shattered these armors also revealed a weakness in their design.
The Bound Soul Ingot stabilizes the cursed energy remarkably well. It seems this relic wasn't forged to destroy the Possessed Armors, but to withstand them.
I've successfully pieced together the original design. This emblem channels the cursed remnants into a protective ward against the Possessed Armors.
The research is complete. I can now forge an Antique Emblem using these recovered materials.
These armor fragments still carry traces of a lingering curse. Combined with this core... there may be enough evidence to reconstruct the relic they once feared.
research.mythsandlegends.chronicler.requ: I need to unlock more knowledge before I can research this.
research.mythsandlegends.chronicler.rese: These findings belong to another scholar. I cannot abandon their research.
This research belongs to another adventurer
I'm busy researching other adventurer's research
research.mythsandlegends.gargoyle_anatom: The anatomy of the gargoyle is finally understood. These creatures are not carved statues brought to life, but ancient guardians shaped through forgotten magic.
The head reveals a complex design, far beyond simple carved stone. These creatures were crafted with a purpose unknown to most.
The torso shows signs of unnatural construction. Stone, magic, and forgotten craftsmanship were fused together to create a living guardian.
The wings are unlike any ordinary structure. Their composition suggests gargoyles were not merely statues, but beings capable of movement and life.
The study of the gargoyle is finished. Its ancient design and forgotten craftsmanship have been preserved in my records.
The remains of a gargoyle hold secrets hidden beneath layers of ancient stone. I shall begin examining its structure.
research.mythsandlegends.gargoyle_arsena: The legacy of the stone guardians is now preserved. Their ancient protection and power are mine to wield.
The structure of gargoyle stone is unlike ordinary rock. Each piece was shaped with purpose, designed to endure centuries of conflict.
The ancient designs begin to make sense. These weapons were forged to channel the strength of the guardians themselves.
The final inscriptions reveal the truth. The axe and shield were symbols of the gargoyles' eternal duty, not merely tools of war.
The forgotten techniques of the gargoyle guardians have been restored. Their strength can now be carried once more.
The stone guardians of old were not created only to protect. Their weapons reveal a forgotten craftsmanship hidden within their ancient forms.
research.mythsandlegends.higa_amulet.com: May its blessing stand between you and the darkness that seeks your soul.
research.mythsandlegends.higa_amulet.pro: The markings are unlike ordinary charms. Each line appears woven with protective intent.
Fascinating... this amulet does not repel evil outright. Instead, it waits until its bearer is in greatest peril.
The final symbols are becoming clear. This relic was crafted to preserve hope when all else had failed.
research.mythsandlegends.higa_amulet.rea: At last. The secrets behind this protective charm have been revealed.
research.mythsandlegends.higa_amulet.sta: An ancient ward against unseen curses... its craftsmanship speaks of knowledge long forgotten.
research.mythsandlegends.missing_prerequ: You must complete previous research before studying this subject.
research.mythsandlegends.molten_fist.com: The power sealed within the Molten Fist is now understood. The wrath of Abaddon answers my call.
research.mythsandlegends.molten_fist.pro: The Abaddon Core still burns with an unnatural force. Its energy refuses to fade, even after being separated from its original host.
The scorched remains begin to merge with the core. This weapon was not forged... it was awakened.
The final secrets are revealed. The Molten Fist is a relic of pure destruction, carrying the fury of a creature that defied the natural order.
research.mythsandlegends.molten_fist.rea: The knowledge of the Molten Fist has been uncovered. Its flames await a worthy bearer.
research.mythsandlegends.molten_fist.sta: Ancient records describe a weapon born from destruction itself. The remains of Abaddon may hold the secret to harnessing its overwhelming power.
research.mythsandlegends.nightfrost.comp: The wisdom of the old hunters flows through my hands. The Nightfrost legacy is no longer forgotten.
research.mythsandlegends.nightfrost.prog: The Glacial Binding carries a strange energy, as if the cold itself had been preserved within its core. This material is unlike anything found in the mortal world.
The frost within the binding responds to the crafted pieces. These tools were not made merely to endure the cold, but to command it.
The forgotten craft reveals itself... Nightfrost. A toolset created by ancient hunters who mastered the frozen realms.
research.mythsandlegends.nightfrost.read: The ancient frostbound techniques have revealed themselves. The Nightfrost craft awaits its revival.
research.mythsandlegends.nightfrost.star: Ancient records tell of tools forged from the essence of the frozen wilds. The Amarok's icy relic may hold the key to uncovering their secrets.
research.mythsandlegends.noctifer_tenebr: The knowledge of Noctifer Tenebris is already mine.
The refined Tenebrite resonates with the Bound Soul Ingots. There is power hidden within this alloy.
The weapon seems to crave darkness, almost as if it were alive.
Its true name reveals itself... Noctifer Tenebris. A relic forged for those who embrace the Umbral.
The secrets behind Noctifer Tenebris have been uncovered.
Ancient manuscripts speak of a blade that commands the darkness itself. Perhaps they were not mere legends.
research.mythsandlegends.random.breakthr: The Chronicler made an unexpected breakthrough!
research.mythsandlegends.random.distract: The Chronicler became distracted for a moment.
research.mythsandlegends.random.focused: The Chronicler entered a state of deep concentration.
research.mythsandlegends.random.master_i: A brilliant insight dramatically accelerated the research!
research.mythsandlegends.random.mistake: The Chronicler made a mistake and had to retrace some steps.
research.mythsandlegends.refined_tenebri: I have already mastered the refinement of Tenebrite.
The impurities react violently when exposed to cursed energy.
Interesting... the shards become far more stable after repeated refinement.
The darkness within has been tempered. The material is finally usable.
The Tenebrite Shards are unstable. I must discover how to refine their umbral essence.
research.mythsandlegends.repeatable: The Chronicler carefully recreates his previous findings...
research.mythsandlegends.sanctum_table.c: The fragments have revealed all they could. The knowledge of the Stone Sanctum Table is now yours.
research.mythsandlegends.sanctum_table.p: The carved patterns align perfectly. This wasn't ordinary masonry—it was crafted with remarkable precision.
Interesting... these fragments belonged to an ancient workstation. Its surface bears traces of rituals and countless years of use.
I've reconstructed the missing sections. This structure served as a sanctum where knowledge and craftsmanship came together.
research.mythsandlegends.sanctum_table.r: The reconstruction is complete. I can now teach you how to build the Stone Sanctum Table.
research.mythsandlegends.sanctum_table.s: These stone fragments... they're clearly part of something larger. Give me some time, and I'll determine what they once formed.
research.mythsandlegends.tainted_spirit_: May its chime guide wandering souls back into silence.
These inscriptions speak of rites meant to silence restless spirits, though time has twisted their meaning.
Its tone was never meant to harm the living... only those who refused to leave this world behind.
I believe the corruption can be understood. Soon, we shall restore the bell's forgotten purpose.
Remarkable. The bell's true resonance has finally been restored.
Curious... this bell still resonates, despite the corruption clinging to it. Let us uncover its true purpose.
research.mythsandlegends.torngarsuk_bles: May Torngarsuk's blessing guide your hunt and steady your hand.
Curious... The Karakondjul's hide resists the freezing energy instead of rejecting it.
These markings speak of an ancient guardian. This was never meant to be a mere trophy.
I understand now. The essence is not a source of power—it is a vessel awaiting a worthy bearer.
At last! I have uncovered the method to forge Torngarsuk's sacred necklace.
The Amarok's essence still carries an unnatural chill... Perhaps it can reveal the blessing once granted by Torngarsuk.
The craftsmanship of the Winter Stalker armor has already been mastered.
The hide is remarkably dense, trapping warmth without sacrificing movement.
Layers of frost seem to strengthen the pelt instead of weakening it. An unusual property indeed.
At last... the techniques of the Winter Stalkers reveal themselves. This armor was made for hunters of frozen lands.
The Winter Stalker armor designs are ready for forging.
The Karakondjul survives where few creatures dare to tread. Its pelt may hold the secret to enduring the endless winter.

spell.irons_spellbooks.blizzard.guide: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.
spell.irons_spellbooks.blood_needles.gui: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done
spell.irons_spellbooks.blood_slash.guide: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.
spell.irons_spellbooks.blood_step.guide: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.
spell.irons_spellbooks.burning_dash.guid: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.
spell.irons_spellbooks.chain_creeper.gui: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.
spell.irons_spellbooks.chain_lightning.g: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures
spell.irons_spellbooks.charge.guide: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.
spell.irons_spellbooks.cleanse.guide: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.
spell.irons_spellbooks.cloud_of_regenera: Hold to slowly heal friendly creatures within a radius around you.
spell.irons_spellbooks.cone_of_cold.guid: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.
spell.irons_spellbooks.counterspell.guid: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.
spell.irons_spellbooks.creeper_revenge.g: The creeper tryna steal my stuff again
spell.irons_spellbooks.devour.guide: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.
spell.irons_spellbooks.divine_smite.guid: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spell.irons_spellbooks.dragon_breath.gui: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.
spell.irons_spellbooks.earthquake.guide: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.
spell.irons_spellbooks.echoing_strikes.g: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.eldritch_blast.gu: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.
spell.irons_spellbooks.electrocute.guide: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.
spell.irons_spellbooks.evasion.guide: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fang_strike.guide: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fang_swirl.guide: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fang_ward.guide: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fire_arrow.guide: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fire_breath.guide: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fireball.guide: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.
spell.irons_spellbooks.firebolt.guide: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.
spell.irons_spellbooks.firecracker.guide: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.
spell.irons_spellbooks.firefly_swarm.gui: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.
spell.irons_spellbooks.flaming_barrage.g: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.
spell.irons_spellbooks.flaming_strike.gu: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fortify.guide: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.
spell.irons_spellbooks.frost_step.guide: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.frostbite.guide: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.frostwave.guide: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
spell.irons_spellbooks.gluttony.guide: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.gravity_fissure.g: Split from the air a miniature Black Hole that moves forward in a line, pulling nearby creatures into its gravity well, but dealing no damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.greater_heal.guid: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.
spell.irons_spellbooks.guiding_bolt.guid: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them
spell.irons_spellbooks.gust.guide: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall
spell.irons_spellbooks.haste.guide: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.heal.guide: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.
spell.irons_spellbooks.healing_circle.gu: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within
spell.irons_spellbooks.heartstop.guide: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.
spell.irons_spellbooks.heat_surge.guide: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ice_block.guide: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ice_spikes.guide: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ice_tomb.guide: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.
spell.irons_spellbooks.icicle.guide: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.
spell.irons_spellbooks.invisibility.guid: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.
spell.irons_spellbooks.lightning_bolt.gu: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.
spell.irons_spellbooks.lightning_lance.g: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.
spell.irons_spellbooks.lob_creeper.guide: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
spell.irons_spellbooks.magic_arrow.guide: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.
spell.irons_spellbooks.magic_missile.gui: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.
spell.irons_spellbooks.magma_bomb.guide: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands
spell.irons_spellbooks.oakskin.guide: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.planar_sight.guid: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.
Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.
spell.irons_spellbooks.poison_arrow.guid: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact
spell.irons_spellbooks.poison_breath.gui: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach
spell.irons_spellbooks.poison_splash.gui: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud
spell.irons_spellbooks.portal.guide: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.
spell.irons_spellbooks.raise_dead.guide: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.
spell.irons_spellbooks.raise_hell.guide: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ray_of_frost.guid: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.
Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.
spell.irons_spellbooks.recall.guide: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.
spell.irons_spellbooks.root.guide: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement
spell.irons_spellbooks.sacrifice.guide: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.
spell.irons_spellbooks.scapegoat.guide: Conjure a magical decoy in the form of a goat, which takes aggro from nearby hostile mobs and runs off into the distance, taunting them for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.scorch.guide: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.
spell.irons_spellbooks.sculk_tentacles.g: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.
spell.irons_spellbooks.shadow_slash.guid: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spell.irons_spellbooks.shield.guide: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.
spell.irons_spellbooks.shockwave.guide: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.
spell.irons_spellbooks.slow.guide: Apply the Slowed effect to a targeted creature, decreasing its movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.snowball.guide: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
spell.irons_spellbooks.sonic_boom.guide: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.
spell.irons_spellbooks.spectral_hammer.g: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.
spell.irons_spellbooks.spider_aspect.gui: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned
spell.irons_spellbooks.starfall.guide: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell
spell.irons_spellbooks.stomp.guide: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.
spell.irons_spellbooks.summon_ender_ches: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.
spell.irons_spellbooks.summon_horse.guid: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.
spell.irons_spellbooks.summon_polar_bear: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.
spell.irons_spellbooks.summon_swords.gui: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.
spell.irons_spellbooks.summon_vex.guide: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.
spell.irons_spellbooks.sunbeam.guide: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.
spell.irons_spellbooks.telekinesis.guide: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.teleport.guide: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.
spell.irons_spellbooks.throw.guide: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.
spell.irons_spellbooks.thunder_step.guid: Teleport a short distance forward, creating a wake of lightning that damages creatures you teleport through.
spell.irons_spellbooks.thunderstorm.guid: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.touch_dig.guide: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.
spell.irons_spellbooks.void_tentacles.gu: From where you look, erupt a mass of void energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.
spell.irons_spellbooks.volt_strike.guide: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.
spell.irons_spellbooks.wall_of_fire.guid: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.
spell.irons_spellbooks.wisp.guide: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.
spell.irons_spellbooks.wither_skull.guid: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.
spell.paladins.barrier.description: Summons a circular barrier, protecting you and allies from projectiles, magic or enemies intruding the area.
spell.paladins.barrier.name: Barrier

spell.paladins.battle_banner.name: Battle Banner
spell.paladins.blessed_strikes.descripti: Channels holy light into your weapon, blessing it up to 5 times. Each melee strike spends a blessing to deal {damage} additional spell damage.
spell.paladins.blessed_strikes.name: Blessed Strikes
spell.paladins.circle_of_healing.descrip: Heals you and friendly targets around you by {heal}.
spell.paladins.circle_of_healing.name: Circle of Healing
spell.paladins.divine_protection.descrip: Protects you from the next incoming attacks (up to {effect_amplifier_cap}), for {effect_duration} seconds.

spell.paladins.heal.description: Heals you or a friendly target by {heal} health points.
spell.paladins.heal.name: Heal
spell.paladins.holy_beam.description: Channels a beam of light, healing friends by {heal}, and dealing {damage} spell damage to enemies every second.
spell.paladins.holy_beam.name: Holy Light
spell.paladins.holy_shock.description: Heals you or a friendly target by {heal}, smites an enemy dealing {damage} spell damage.
spell.paladins.holy_shock.name: Holy Shock
spell.paladins.immolation.description: Erupts in holy fire, dealing {damage} damage to nearby enemies and setting them ablaze, while healing you and nearby allies by {heal}.
spell.paladins.immolation.name: Immolation
spell.paladins.judgement.description: Strikes your target and enemies around it, within {impact_range} blocks, causing up to {damage} damage and stunning them for {effect_duration} seconds.
spell.paladins.judgement.name: Judgement
spell.paladins.levitate.description: Channel to rise into the air on holy light. When you stop, you keep floating and drift gently back down.
spell.paladins.levitate.name: Levitate
spell.paladins.lightwell.description: Summons a Lightwell that heals you and nearby wounded allies. It lasts {summon_duration} sec.
spell.paladins.lightwell.name: Lightwell
spell.paladins.lightwell_heal.descriptio: Heals a friendly target by {heal} health points.
spell.paladins.lightwell_heal.name: Heal
spell.paladins.penance.description: Channel a volley of holy bolts at an enemy. Each of the three bolts deals {damage} damage and radiates an absorption shield to allies within {impact_range} blocks of your target — your offense is their protection.
spell.paladins.penance.name: Penance
spell.rogues.bear_trap.description: Set 3 bear traps around you, lasting {cloud_duration} sec. The first enemy to step into a trap springs it shut, taking {damage} damage and being held in place for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.bear_trap.name: Bear Trap
spell.rogues.charge.description: Increases movement speed and knockback resistance, lasts for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.charge.name: Charge
spell.rogues.last_stand.description: Stand your ground while channeling. Each stack increases your maximum health and knockback resistance, up to +100%% at {effect_amplifier_cap} stacks. Lasts {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.last_stand.name: Last Stand
spell.rogues.mortal_strike.description: Perform an overhead strike for {weapon_damage_bonus} bonus weapon damage, causing the target to Bleed for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
spell.rogues.mutilate.description: Tear into everything in front of you with both weapons. Strikes with the damage of both held weapons.
spell.rogues.mutilate.name: Mutilate
spell.rogues.shadow_step.description: Step through the shadows to appear behind your target.
spell.rogues.shadow_step.name: Shadowstep
spell.rogues.shock_powder.name: Shock Powder
spell.rogues.shout.description: Shout at nearby enemies, reducing their attack damage by {effect|rogues:demoralize|0||abs} for {effect_duration} sec, and dealing a small amount of damage.
spell.rogues.shout.name: Demoralizing Shout
spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.description: Enter a battle trance, during which your attacks will each grant extra power, stacking up to {effect_amplifier_cap} times. Expires after {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.name: Slice & Dice
spell.rogues.throw.description: Throw your weapon at the target, dealing {damage} damage and reducing their armor by {effect|rogues:shatter|0||abs} for {effect_duration} sec. The longer the cast is held, the harder it hits and the further it flies.
spell.rogues.throw.name: Shattering Throw
spell.rogues.throw_net.description: Hurl a weighted net, dealing {damage} damage and pinning the target in place for {effect_duration} sec. The longer the cast is held, the harder it lands and the further it flies.
spell.rogues.throw_net.name: Throw Net
spell.rogues.vanish.description: Vanish from sight, entering stealth for {effect_duration} sec. Performing any action or taking damage will break the effect.
spell.rogues.vanish.name: Vanish

text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_awaken: A chill runs through your spine... The Black Charro rides again!
text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_combat: I don’t grant mercy. Only graves.
Do you think you can control me? I am the rider of darkness.
The night belongs to me, mortal.
Run all you want, you can't escape my judgment.
The price of power is higher than you can imagine.
text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_day_fa: The Black Charro's power wanes under the daylight. Try again when shadows reign.
text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_fail: The shadows linger, unbroken... Your offering was unworthy of their gaze.
text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_gets_d: Today I forgive you, but remember my shadow will always follow you.
You may have won this time, but no one escapes the judgment of the night.
I fall today, but remember: I am never truly gone.
Defeat is but a fleeting shadow. One day, we shall meet again.
Even in death, I will haunt your steps. The darkness never truly fades.
text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_kills_: Your power is intriguing... but not enough to impress me.
Now your soul belongs to me!
Your feeble light has been extinguished.
You should've stayed away, foolish mortal.
text.mythsandlegends.black_charro_summon: Rise from the void, condemned soul. Obey my will!
Awaken, lost spirit. Your torment is not yet over!
TBy my command, the shadows stir once more!
Wraiths of pain and sorrow, answer my summons!
Another forsaken soul joins my legion
Your chains are broken—serve me in undeath!
text.mythsandlegends.blood_moon_end.mess: §7The oppressive presence that haunted the night has lifted.
text.mythsandlegends.blood_moon_end.subt: The restless dead return to silence.
text.mythsandlegends.blood_moon_start.me: §7An unsettling chill spreads as the moon drinks the night.
text.mythsandlegends.blood_moon_start.su: The dead remember the way home.
§7An unsettling silence falls upon the land. Something stirs with the coming dusk.
text.mythsandlegends.chronicler_interest: Your expedition has attracted the attention of a curious observer...
tooltip.aquamirae.cooked_spinefish: Now it draws attention... especially with a side dish.
tooltip.aquamirae.echo_compass: Resonates with the nearest Ship Graveyard Echo, attuned to its lingering call.
tooltip.aquamirae.esca_skewer: Its eerie glow stirs an insatiable hunger.
tooltip.aquamirae.frozen_key: Opens a chest hidden in the depths of the Ice Maze.
tooltip.aquamirae.golden_moth_jar: Some treasures can have their own souls, not only devour others...
tooltip.aquamirae.jellyfish_jelly: A Scuttler's favorite treat. Some simply can't stop eating it.
tooltip.aquamirae.luminescent_bubble: Its gentle current hastens nearby swimmers.
tooltip.aquamirae.luminescent_lamp: An eerie glow that never fades.
tooltip.aquamirae.niveis_tear: Wisteria Niveis distilled. Stand in a Blizzard, and the Maelstrom will find you.
tooltip.aquamirae.pirate_pouch: [color=light_purple]Right-click to open.[/color] [/br][/br] Only the stench remains, along with a hint of a once turbulent life.
tooltip.aquamirae.shell_horn: [color=light_purple]Summons Captain Cornelia.[/color] [/br][/br] Can be used near water in the Ice Maze.
tooltip.aquamirae.ship_graveyard_echo: If you listen carefully, you can hear the horns of hundreds of ships lost in the Ice Maze...
tooltip.aquamirae.smithing_template: Armor forged from Ice Maze remains offers greater protection against its creatures.
tooltip.aquamirae.spinefish: Disguises itself as remains to avoid unwanted attention.
tooltip.aquamirae.treasure_pouch: [color=light_purple]Right-click to open.[/color] [/br][/br] A treasure that outlasted the ship, the crew, and the very reason it was kept.
tooltip.aquamirae.void_squid: Upon consuming, each hit drains 1 hunger shank instead of health. Starving rapidly drains health.
